item.title: github: Actions retention now covers checks, runs, and statuses
item.description:
GitHub Actions retention now applies to checks, workflow runs, and statuses, using the same retention setting that already controls artifacts and logs. This means those records are now kept or removed according to the repository or organization Actions retention policy.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: Actions retention will cover checks, workflow runs, and statuses
item.description:
Starting October 1, 2026, GitHub Actions retention settings will also apply to checks, workflow runs, and statuses, in addition to artifacts and logs. These data types will follow the same retention policy going forward.

  • Source: GitHub
